text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned having right groin pain and an abnormal leg position after a rear-end collision; can you tell me exactly how your leg was positioned immediately after the accident?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Right Femoral Neck Fracture.

The history of a rear-end collision with immediate severe groin pain and abnormal leg positioning is classic for this injury, even though the patient also reports knee pain. I am ready to proceed with a specific imaging request to confirm the diagnosis.
